content.introduction: The sources indicate that the FAAMG group of mega-cap tech companies is preparing to report their quarterly results, with high expectations following upward revisions to profit and sales estimates. The first company to report is Microsoft, followed by Alphabet, Meta Platforms, and Amazon, with Apple scheduled for the following week. Specific earnings estimates include Alphabet's expected Q2 profit of $1.34 per share, a 10.7% increase from the same quarter last year, and revenue forecast of $72.66 billion, marking the third-highest quarterly sales total in the company’s history. Apple is expected to report earnings per share of $1.55 and revenue of $94.2 billion. The focus for Alphabet will be on its core advertising business and YouTube's performance.
body:
## Final Thoughts

As the FAAMG group of mega cap tech companies prepare to report their quarterly results, expectations are high following significant upward revisions to both profit and sales estimates.

These tech titans are expected to deliver strong performances across their key business segments, driven by innovation, cloud growth, digital advertising, and AI-driven advancements. [...] With a market cap of $1.96 trillion, the Seattle, Washington-based e-commerce and cloud giant is the fifth most valuable company listed on the U.S. stock exchange.

## 5. Apple

   Earnings Date: Thursday, Oct. 31
   EPS Estimate: $1.55 (+6.1% Y/Y)
   Revenue Estimate: $94.2B (+5.3% Y/Y)

Apple will be the final ‘FAAMG’ stock to report quarterly results when it delivers fiscal fourth-quarter earnings after the market closes at 4:30PM ET on Thursday, October 31. [...] Alphabet, Google’s parent company, will be the first ‘FAAMG’ company to report earnings when it delivers its latest quarterly results after U.S. markets close on Tuesday, October 29, at 4:00 PM ET.

The focus will be on its core advertising business, which remains the tech giant’s main revenue driver. Investors will be closely watching YouTube's performance as well, especially after changes in its Shorts and advertising strategies.

Consensus calls for the Seattle, Washington-based tech titan to post earnings per share of $0.22, compared to a rare loss of $0.37 per share in Q1 2022, thanks to the positive impact of several cost-saving measures implemented in recent months.

Revenue is expected to increase 7% from the year-ago period to $124.6 billion, reflecting ongoing strength in its cloud computing business. [...] Consensus estimates call for the tech giant to report a Q1 profit of $1.07 per share, slumping 13% from EPS of $1.23 in the same quarter a year earlier, amid elevated operating costs and charges tied to employee severance expenses.

Revenue is forecast to increase roughly 1% from the year-ago period to $68.81 billion due to the negative impact of the overall pullback in ad spending. [...] Stock Performances

As such, there will be a lot on the line when the so-called ‘FAAMG’ group of mega-cap companies report their respective results, with Wall Street expecting another tough quarter for Big Tech earnings.

## Microsoft

Microsoft will be the first mega-cap tech company to report earnings when it delivers its latest quarterly results after U.S. markets close on Tuesday, April 25, at 16:05 ET (20:05 GMT).

GOOGL Earnings DataSource: InvestingPro

Consensus estimates call for Alphabet to report Q2 profit of $1.34 per share, rising 10.7% from EPS of $1.21 in the same quarter a year earlier, as the tech giant continues to reap the benefits of ongoing cost-cutting measures.

Revenue is forecast to increase roughly 4% from the year-ago period to $72.66 billion, which if confirmed would mark the third-highest quarterly sales total in the company’s history. [...] AAPL-0.52%

 Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta Platforms, and Amazon report earnings next week, with Apple scheduled for the following week.
 ‘FAAMG’ profit, revenue growth, guidance updates will be the next test for the ongoing market rally.
 Here’s what to watch for when the Big Five mega-cap tech stocks release their upcoming results. [...] Google-parent Alphabet is set to deliver its second-quarter earnings and revenue update after the U.S. market closes on Tuesday, July 25 at 16:15 ET (20:15 GMT) and results are expected to get a boost from a strong performance in its search and cloud-computing businesses.

Analysts have become increasingly bullish ahead of the print, according to an InvestingPro survey: of the 28 analysts surveyed, 23 upwardly revised their GOOGL earnings forecast, while only five made downward revisions.
